translations.web: “ ‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You must not make any cuts in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.
translations.kjv: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
translations.asv: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am Jehovah.
